# Fireblocks Developer Docs

## Docs

- [Update admin quorum threshold](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/admin-quorum/update-admin-quorum-threshold.md): Update admin quorum threshold
- [Create API Key](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/api-user/create-api-key.md): Create a new API key in your workspace. Learn more about Fireblocks API Keys management in the following [guide](https://developers.fireblocks.com/docs/manage-api-keys). Endpoint Permission: Admin, Non-Signing Admin.
- [Get API Keys](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/api-user/get-api-keys.md): List all API keys in your workspace. - Please note that this endpoint is available only for API keys with Admin/Non Signing Admin permissions. Endpoint Permission: Admin, Non-Signing Admin.
- [Get audit logs](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/audit-logs/get-audit-logs.md): Get Audit logs for the last Day/Week.
- [Get a Blockchain by ID](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/blockchains-&-assets/get-a-blockchain-by-id.md): Returns a blockchain by ID or legacyID.
- [Get an asset](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/blockchains-&-assets/get-an-asset.md): Returns an asset by ID or legacyID.
- [List assets](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/blockchains-&-assets/list-assets.md): Retrieves a paginated list of all assets supported by Fireblocks in your workspace
- [List assets (Legacy)](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/blockchains-&-assets/list-assets-legacy.md): **This legacy endpoint has not been deprecated but it should not be used in your operations. Instead, use the new [List assets](https://developers.fireblocks.com/reference/listassets) endpoint for better performance and to retrieve more detailed asset information.**
- [List blockchains](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/blockchains-&-assets/list-blockchains.md): Returns all blockchains supported by Fireblocks.
- [Register an asset](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/blockchains-&-assets/register-an-asset.md): Register a new asset to a workspace and return the newly created asset's details. Currently supported chains are: - EVM based chains - Stellar - Algorand - TRON - NEAR - Solana - Sui - TON
- [Set asset price](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/blockchains-&-assets/set-asset-price.md): Set asset price for the given asset id. Returns the asset price response.
- [Update the user’s metadata for an asset](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/blockchains-&-assets/update-the-user’s-metadata-for-an-asset.md): Update the user’s metadata for an asset.
- [Get AML Screening Policy Configuration](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/compliance-screening-configuration/get-aml-screening-policy-configuration.md): Retrieves the configuration for Travel Rule screening policy.
- [Get Travel Rule Screening Policy Configuration](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/compliance-screening-configuration/get-travel-rule-screening-policy-configuration.md): Retrieves the configuration for Travel Rule screening policy.
- [Activate BYORK Light](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/compliance/activate-byork-light.md): Activates BYORK Light for the authenticated tenant (sets config.active to true). Once activated, BYORK screening applies to matching transactions. Requires BYORK Light to be enabled for the tenant (contact your CSM to enable).
- [Add vault accounts to the address registry opt-out list](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/compliance/add-vault-accounts-to-the-address-registry-opt-out-list.md): Adds one or more vault account ids to the workspace opt-out list for the address registry.
- [AML - View Post-Screening Policy](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/compliance/aml--view-post-screening-policy.md): Get the post-screening policy for AML.
- [AML - View Screening Policy](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/compliance/aml--view-screening-policy.md): Get the screening policy for AML.
- [Assign vault accounts to a legal entity](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/compliance/assign-vault-accounts-to-a-legal-entity.md): Assigns one or more vault accounts to a specific legal entity registration. Explicitly mapped vault accounts take precedence over the workspace default legal entity. Endpoint Permission: Admin, Non-Signing Admin.
- [Calling the "Bypass Screening Policy" API endpoint triggers a new transaction, with the API user as the initiator, bypassing the screening policy check](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/compliance/calling-the-"bypass-screening-policy"-api-endpoint-triggers-a-new-transaction-with-the-api-user-as-the-initiator-bypassing-the-screening-policy-check.md): This endpoint is restricted to Admin API users and is only applicable to outgoing transactions.
- [Create a counterparty group](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/compliance/create-a-counterparty-group.md): Creates a new counterparty group.
- [Deactivate BYORK Light](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/compliance/deactivate-byork-light.md): Deactivates BYORK Light for the authenticated tenant (sets config.active to false). Once deactivated, BYORK screening no longer applies until activated again. Requires BYORK Light to be enabled for the tenant (contact your CSM to enable).
- [Delete a counterparty group](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/compliance/delete-a-counterparty-group.md): Permanently deletes a counterparty group.
- [Get a counterparty group](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/compliance/get-a-counterparty-group.md): Returns the details of a specific counterparty group.
- [Get a legal entity](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/compliance/get-a-legal-entity.md): Returns details of a specific legal entity registration, including GLEIF data when available. Endpoint Permission: Admin, Non-Signing Admin, Signer, Approver, Editor, Viewer.
- [Get address registry participation status for the authenticated workspace](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/compliance/get-address-registry-participation-status-for-the-authenticated-workspace.md): Returns whether the workspace is `OPTED_IN` or `OPTED_OUT` of the address registry.
- [Get BYORK Light configuration](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/compliance/get-byork-light-configuration.md): Retrieves BYORK Light configuration for the authenticated tenant (timeouts, active flag, allowed timeout ranges). Returns default config when none exists. Requires BYORK Light to be enabled for the tenant.
- [Get BYORK Light verdict](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/compliance/get-byork-light-verdict.md): Returns the current BYORK verdict and status for a transaction. Status can be PRE_ACCEPTED, PENDING, RECEIVED (verdict is final but processing not yet complete), or COMPLETED. Requires BYORK Light to be enabled for the tenant. Returns 404 if no BYORK verdict is found for the transaction.
- [Get whether a vault account is opted out of the address registry](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/compliance/get-whether-a-vault-account-is-opted-out-of-the-address-registry.md): Returns whether this vault account is on the workspace opt-out list (`optedOut` true or false). List, add, and clear-all are available on `/v1/address_registry/vaults`; this path reads or removes one vault.
- [List counterparty groups](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/compliance/list-counterparty-groups.md): Returns a paginated list of counterparty groups.
- [List legal entities (Paginated)](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/compliance/list-legal-entities-paginated.md): Returns legal entity registrations for the workspace with cursor-based pagination. If query parameter vaultAccountId is used it returns the legal entity registration associated with a specific vault account. If no explicit mapping exists for the vault, the workspace default legal entity is returned.…
- [List vault accounts for a legal entity (Paginated)](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/compliance/list-vault-accounts-for-a-legal-entity-paginated.md): Returns vault account IDs explicitly assigned to a specific legal entity registration, with cursor-based pagination. Endpoint Permission: Admin, Non-Signing Admin, Signer, Approver, Editor, Viewer.
- [List vault-level address registry opt-outs (paginated)](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/compliance/list-vault-level-address-registry-opt-outs-paginated.md): Lists vault accounts that are opted out of the address registry for this workspace. Pagination uses `next` and `prev` cursors from the response. If `pageSize` is omitted, **50** items are returned per page; allowed range is **1–100** per request.
- [Look up legal entity by blockchain address](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/compliance/look-up-legal-entity-by-blockchain-address.md): Returns legal entity information for the given blockchain address (verification status, LEI, Travel Rule providers, contact email, and related fields — see response schema). URL-encode `{address}` when required.
- [Opt the workspace in to the address registry](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/compliance/opt-the-workspace-in-to-the-address-registry.md): Opts the workspace in. No request body. Response uses the same JSON shape as GET; status is OPTED_IN.
- [Opt the workspace out of the address registry](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/compliance/opt-the-workspace-out-of-the-address-registry.md): Opts the workspace out. No request body. Response uses the same JSON shape as GET; status is OPTED_OUT.
- [Provides all the compliance details for the given screened transaction.](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/compliance/provides-all-the-compliance-details-for-the-given-screened-transaction.md): Provides all the compliance details for the given screened transaction.
- [Register a new legal entity](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/compliance/register-a-new-legal-entity.md): Registers a new legal entity for the workspace using its LEI (Legal Entity Identifier) code. The LEI is validated against the GLEIF registry. Each workspace can register multiple legal entities. Endpoint Permission: Admin, Non-Signing Admin.
- [Remove a single vault account from the address registry opt-out list](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/compliance/remove-a-single-vault-account-from-the-address-registry-opt-out-list.md): Removes this vault account id from the workspace opt-out list if it is present; otherwise the call still succeeds. Response body matches GET (`optedOut` is `false` after success). To clear the whole list, use `DELETE /v1/address_registry/vaults`.
- [Remove all vault-level address registry opt-outs for the workspace](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/compliance/remove-all-vault-level-address-registry-opt-outs-for-the-workspace.md): Removes all vault accounts from the workspace opt-out list.
- [Set AML Verdict (BYORK Super Light)](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/compliance/set-aml-verdict-byork-super-light.md): Set AML verdict for incoming transactions when **BYORK Super Light** (Manual Screening Verdict) is enabled. This endpoint is for Super Light only. For **BYORK Light**, use POST /screening/byork/verdict instead. When Super Light is retired, this endpoint will be deprecated; use the BYORK Light verdic…
- [Set BYORK Light timeouts](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/compliance/set-byork-light-timeouts.md): Updates timeout values for BYORK wait-for-response (incoming and/or outgoing). At least one of incomingTimeoutSeconds or outgoingTimeoutSeconds is required. Values must be within the ranges returned in GET config (timeoutRangeIncoming for incomingTimeoutSeconds, timeoutRangeOutgoing for outgoingTime…
- [Set BYORK Light verdict](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/compliance/set-byork-light-verdict.md): Submit verdict (ACCEPT or REJECT) for a transaction in the BYORK Light flow. If the transaction is awaiting your decision, the verdict is applied immediately (response status COMPLETED). If processing has not yet reached that point, the verdict is stored and applied when it does (response status PRE…
- [Tenant - Screening Configuration](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/compliance/tenant--screening-configuration.md): Update tenant screening configuration.
- [Travel Rule - View Post-Screening Policy](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/compliance/travel-rule--view-post-screening-policy.md): Get the post-screening policy for Travel Rule.
- [Travel Rule - View Screening Policy](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/compliance/travel-rule--view-screening-policy.md): Get the screening policy for Travel Rule.
- [Update a counterparty group](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/compliance/update-a-counterparty-group.md): Updates an existing counterparty group.
- [Update AML Configuration](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/compliance/update-aml-configuration.md): Updates bypass screening, inbound delay, or outbound delay configurations for AML.
- [Update legal entity](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/compliance/update-legal-entity.md): Updates the status of a legal entity registration. Setting isDefault to true marks the registration as the workspace default, which is applied to vault accounts that have no explicit legal entity mapping. Endpoint Permission: Admin, Non-Signing Admin.
- [Update Travel Rule Configuration](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/compliance/update-travel-rule-configuration.md): Updates bypass screening, inbound delay, or outbound delay configurations for Travel Rule.
- [Disconnect connected account](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/connected-accounts-beta/disconnect-connected-account.md): Disconnect a connected account by ID.
- [Get balances for an account](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/connected-accounts-beta/get-balances-for-an-account.md): Retrieve current asset balances for a specific connected account as a flat list (one row per `assetId`, `balanceType`).
- [Get connected account](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/connected-accounts-beta/get-connected-account.md): Retrieve detailed information about a specific connected account by ID.
- [Get connected accounts](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/connected-accounts-beta/get-connected-accounts.md): Returns all connected accounts.
- [Get exchange rates for an account](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/connected-accounts-beta/get-exchange-rates-for-an-account.md): Retrieve current exchange rates for converting between specific assets in a connected account.
- [Get supported trading pairs for an account](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/connected-accounts-beta/get-supported-trading-pairs-for-an-account.md): Retrieve all asset trading pairs supported by a specific connected account, including the pair type (`quote`, `market`, `onOffRamp`).
- [Rename Connected Account](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/connected-accounts-beta/rename-connected-account.md): Rename a connected account by account ID.
- [Create console user](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/console-user/create-console-user.md): Create console users in your workspace - Please note that this endpoint is available only for API keys with Admin/Non Signing Admin permissions. Learn more about Fireblocks Users management in the following [guide](https://developers.fireblocks.com/docs/manage-users). Endpoint Permission: Admin, Non…
- [Get console users](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/console-user/get-console-users.md): Get console users for your workspace. - Please note that this endpoint is available only for API keys with Admin/Non Signing Admin permissions. Endpoint Permission: Admin, Non-Signing Admin.
- [Call a read function on a deployed contract](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/contract-interactions/call-a-read-function-on-a-deployed-contract.md): Call a read function on a deployed contract by blockchain native asset id and contract address
- [Call a write function on a deployed contract](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/contract-interactions/call-a-write-function-on-a-deployed-contract.md): Call a write function on a deployed contract by blockchain native asset id and contract address. This creates an onchain transaction, thus it is an async operation. It returns a transaction id that can be polled for status check
- [Decode a function call data, error, or event log](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/contract-interactions/decode-a-function-call-data-error-or-event-log.md): Decode a function call data, error, or event log from a deployed contract by blockchain native asset id and contract address.
- [Get contract address by transaction hash](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/contract-interactions/get-contract-address-by-transaction-hash.md): Retrieve the contract address by blockchain native asset ID and transaction hash
- [Get transaction receipt](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/contract-interactions/get-transaction-receipt.md): Retrieve the transaction receipt by blockchain native asset ID and transaction hash > **Note** > This functionality is exclusively available for EVM (Ethereum Virtual Machine) compatible chains.  Endpoint Permission: Admin, Non-Signing Admin, Signer, Approver, Editor, and Viewer.
- [Return deployed contract's ABI](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/contract-interactions/return-deployed-contracts-abi.md): Return deployed contract's ABI by blockchain native asset id and contract address. Endpoint Permission: Admin, Non-Signing Admin, Signer, Approver, Editor, and Viewer.
- [Delete a contract template by id](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/contract-templates/delete-a-contract-template-by-id.md): Delete a contract by id. allowed only for private contract templates. Notice: it is irreversible!
- [Deploy contract](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/contract-templates/deploy-contract.md): Deploy a new contract by contract template id. If you wish to deploy a token (ERC20, ERC721 etc), and create asset please use POST /tokenization
- [Get supported blockchains for the template](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/contract-templates/get-supported-blockchains-for-the-template.md): Get supported blockchains for the template
- [List all contract templates](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/contract-templates/list-all-contract-templates.md): Return minimal representation of all the contract templates available for the workspace. Endpoint Permission: Admin, Non-Signing Admin, Signer, Approver, Editor, Viewer.
- [Return contract template by id](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/contract-templates/return-contract-template-by-id.md): Return detailed information about the contract template
- [Return contract template's constructor](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/contract-templates/return-contract-templates-constructor.md): Return contract template's constructor ABI
- [Return contract template's function](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/contract-templates/return-contract-templates-function.md): Return contract template`s function ABI by signature
- [Upload contract template](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/contract-templates/upload-contract-template.md): Upload a new contract template. This contract template will be available for the workspace
- [Add a contract](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/contracts/add-a-contract.md): Adds a contract to the workspace whitelist. Endpoint Permission: Admin, Non-Signing Admin, Signer, Approver, Editor.
- [Add an asset to a whitelisted contract](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/contracts/add-an-asset-to-a-whitelisted-contract.md): Adds an asset to a whitelisted contract. Endpoint Permission: Admin, Non-Signing Admin, Signer, Approver, Editor.
- [Delete a contract](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/contracts/delete-a-contract.md): Deletes a contract by ID. Endpoint Permission: Admin, Non-Signing Admin, Signer, Approver, Editor.
- [Delete an asset from a whitelisted contract](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/contracts/delete-an-asset-from-a-whitelisted-contract.md): Deletes a whitelisted contract asset by ID. Endpoint Permission: Admin, Non-Signing Admin, Signer, Approver, Editor.
- [Find a Specific Whitelisted Contract](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/contracts/find-a-specific-whitelisted-contract.md): Returns a whitelisted contract by Fireblocks Contract ID. Endpoint Permission: Admin, Non-Signing Admin, Signer, Approver, Editor.
- [Find a whitelisted contract's asset](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/contracts/find-a-whitelisted-contracts-asset.md): Returns a whitelisted contract's asset by ID. Endpoint Permission: Admin, Non-Signing Admin, Signer, Approver, Editor.
- [List Whitelisted Contracts](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/contracts/list-whitelisted-contracts.md): Gets a list of whitelisted contracts. Endpoint Permission: Admin, Non-Signing Admin, Signer, Approver, Editor, Viewer.
- [Add cosigner](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/cosigners-beta/add-cosigner.md): Add a new cosigner. The cosigner will be pending pairing until the API key is manually paired Endpoint Permission: Admin and Non-Signing Admin.
- [Get all API keys](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/cosigners-beta/get-all-api-keys.md): Get all cosigner paired API keys (paginated). **Note:** These endpoints are currently in beta and might be subject to changes. Endpoint Permission: Admin and Non-Signing Admin.
- [Get all cosigners](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/cosigners-beta/get-all-cosigners.md): Get all workspace cosigners (paginated). **Note:** These endpoints are currently in beta and might be subject to changes. Endpoint Permission: Admin and Non-Signing Admin.
- [Get API key](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/cosigners-beta/get-api-key.md): Get an API key by ID. **Note:** These endpoints are currently in beta and might be subject to changes. Endpoint Permission: Admin and Non-Signing Admin.
- [Get cosigner](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/cosigners-beta/get-cosigner.md): Get a cosigner by ID. **Note:** These endpoints are currently in beta and might be subject to changes. Endpoint Permission: Admin and Non-Signing Admin.
- [Get request status](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/cosigners-beta/get-request-status.md): Get the status of an asynchronous request Endpoint Permission: Admin and Non-Signing Admin.
- [Pair API key](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/cosigners-beta/pair-api-key.md): Pair an API key to a cosigner Endpoint Permission: Admin and Non-Signing Admin.
- [Rename cosigner](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/cosigners-beta/rename-cosigner.md): Rename a cosigner by ID. **Note:** These endpoints are currently in beta and might be subject to changes. Endpoint Permission: Admin and Non-Signing Admin.
- [Unpair API key](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/cosigners-beta/unpair-api-key.md): Unpair an API key from a cosigner Endpoint Permission: Admin and Non-Signing Admin.
- [Update API key callback handler](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/cosigners-beta/update-api-key-callback-handler.md): Update the callback handler of an API key Endpoint Permission: Admin and Non-Signing Admin.
- [Fetch the contract ABI](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/deployed-contracts/fetch-the-contract-abi.md): Fetch the ABI. If not found fetch the ABI from the block explorer
- [List deployed contracts data](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/deployed-contracts/list-deployed-contracts-data.md): Return a filtered lean representation of the deployed contracts data on all blockchains (paginated)
- [Return deployed contract data](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/deployed-contracts/return-deployed-contract-data.md): Return deployed contract data by blockchain native asset id and contract address
- [Return deployed contract data by id](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/deployed-contracts/return-deployed-contract-data-by-id.md): Return deployed contract data by id
- [Save contract ABI](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/deployed-contracts/save-contract-abi.md): Save contract ABI for the tenant
- [Approve earn provider terms of service](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/earn-beta/approve-earn-provider-terms-of-service.md): Approves the lending provider's terms of service for this workspace. When `isTermsApprovalRequired` is true on the provider (see list providers), call this once before creating or executing earn actions with that provider. After success, `GET /earn/providers` reflects `isTermsOfServiceApproved`.
- [Create and execute a lending action (deposit or withdraw)](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/earn-beta/create-and-execute-a-lending-action-deposit-or-withdraw.md): Creates and runs a sequence of on-chain steps for either a deposit into or a withdrawal from an earn vault/market. Specify the operation with `action` in the request body (`DEPOSIT` or `WITHDRAW`).
- [Get a single earn lending action](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/earn-beta/get-a-single-earn-lending-action.md): Returns one lending action by its action sequence id (tenant-scoped).
- [Get list of earn opportunities](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/earn-beta/get-list-of-earn-opportunities.md): Get list of earn opportunities (vaults).
- [Get list of earn positions](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/earn-beta/get-list-of-earn-positions.md): Get list of earn positions for accounts tracked for this workspace.  Optional query parameters filter by chain, provider, and pagination.
- [Get list of earn providers](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/earn-beta/get-list-of-earn-providers.md): Get list of earn providers.
- [List earn lending actions](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/earn-beta/list-earn-lending-actions.md): Returns a paginated list of lending actions (deposits and withdrawals) for the authenticated tenant.
- [Add asset to account](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/embedded-wallets/add-asset-to-account.md): Get the addresses of a specific asset, under a specific account, under a specific Non Custodial Wallet
- [Assign a wallet](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/embedded-wallets/assign-a-wallet.md): Assign a specific Non Custodial Wallet to a user
- [Create a new account](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/embedded-wallets/create-a-new-account.md): Create a new account under a specific Non Custodial Wallet
- [Create a new wallet](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/embedded-wallets/create-a-new-wallet.md): Create new Non Custodial Wallet
- [Get a account](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/embedded-wallets/get-a-account.md): Get a specific account under a specific Non Custodial Wallet
- [Get a wallet](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/embedded-wallets/get-a-wallet.md): Get a wallet
- [Get device key setup state](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/embedded-wallets/get-device-key-setup-state.md): Get the state of the specific device setup key under a specific Non Custodial Wallet
- [Get Embedded Wallet Device](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/embedded-wallets/get-embedded-wallet-device.md): Get specific device for a specific s Wallet
- [Get registered devices - paginated](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/embedded-wallets/get-registered-devices--paginated.md): Get a paginated list of registered devices for a specific Non Custodial Wallet
- [Get the public key for a derivation path](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/embedded-wallets/get-the-public-key-for-a-derivation-path.md): Gets the public key information based on derivation path and signing algorithm within a Non-Custodial Wallet
- [Get the public key of an asset](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/embedded-wallets/get-the-public-key-of-an-asset.md): Gets the public key of an asset associated with a specific account within a Non-Custodial Wallet
- [Get the public key of an asset](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/embedded-wallets/get-the-public-key-of-an-asset-1.md): Gets the public key of an asset associated with a specific account within a Non-Custodial Wallet
- [Get wallet key setup state](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/embedded-wallets/get-wallet-key-setup-state.md): Get the key setup state for a specific Non Custodial Wallet, including required algorithms and device setup status
- [Get wallet Latest Backup details](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/embedded-wallets/get-wallet-latest-backup-details.md): Get wallet Latest Backup details, including the deviceId, and backup time
- [List wallets](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/embedded-wallets/list-wallets.md): Get all Non Custodial Wallets
- [Refresh asset balance](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/embedded-wallets/refresh-asset-balance.md): Refresh the balance of an asset in a specific account
- [Retrieve asset](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/embedded-wallets/retrieve-asset.md): Get asset under a specific account, under a specific Non Custodial Wallet
- [Retrieve asset addresses](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/embedded-wallets/retrieve-asset-addresses.md): Get the addresses of a specific asset, under a specific account, under a specific Non Custodial Wallet

Coinbase (USD to USDC, USDC to USD) and Bitso (MXN to USD) are supported conversions. Learn more about Fireblocks Exchange Connectivity in the following [guide](https://developers.fireblocks.com/docs/connect-to-exchanges-…

External Wallet is a whitelisted address of a wallet that belongs to your users/counterparties. Endpoint Permission: Admin, Non-Signing Admin, Signer, Approver, Editor.

- [Add a new signing key](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/key-link-beta/add-a-new-signing-key.md): Adds a new signing key to the workspace. The added key will be linked to the specific Fireblocks agent user ID. The same user will receive the proof of ownership message to be signed, and upon successful proof, the key will become enabled.
- [Add a new validation key](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/key-link-beta/add-a-new-validation-key.md): Adds a new validation key used to validate signing keys. The new validation key will undergo an approval process by the workspace quorum.
- [Disables a validation key](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/key-link-beta/disables-a-validation-key.md): Allows disabling validation key even if it has not expired yet. It is not allowed to enable the validation key back. Another key has to be used for future validations.
- [Get a signing key by `keyId`](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/key-link-beta/get-a-signing-key-by-`keyid`.md): Returns a signing key if it exists, identified by the specified `keyId`.
- [Get a validation key by `keyId`](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/key-link-beta/get-a-validation-key-by-`keyid`.md): Returns a validation key if it exists, identified by the specified `keyId`.
- [Get list of registered validation keys](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/key-link-beta/get-list-of-registered-validation-keys.md): Returns the list of validation keys in the workspace
- [Get list of signing keys](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/key-link-beta/get-list-of-signing-keys.md): Returns the list of signing keys in the workspace
- [Modify the signing keyId](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/key-link-beta/modify-the-signing-keyid.md): Allows assigning the signing key to a vault account, if it hasn't been assigned to any other vault accounts yet.
- [Set agent user id](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/key-link-beta/set-agent-user-id.md): Can modify existing signing key id if the key is not enabled. The change done in background and will be visible once applied. If key is already enabled (after proof of ownership) the user cannot be changed.
- [Get list of mpc keys](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/keys-beta/get-list-of-mpc-keys.md): Returns a list of MPC signing keys of the workspace. For each key, the list of players associated with it is attached. **Note:**  This endpoint is currently in beta and might be subject to changes.
- [Get list of mpc keys by `userId`](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/keys-beta/get-list-of-mpc-keys-by-`userid`.md): Returns a list of MPC signing keys of a specific user. For each key, the list of players associated with it is attached. **Note:** This endpoint is currently in beta and might be subject to changes.

- [Create Ticket](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/smart-transfer/create-ticket.md): Creates a new Smart Transfer ticket. Learn more about Fireblocks Smart Transfers [here](https://developers.fireblocks.com/docs/execute-smart-transfers).
- [Define funding source](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/smart-transfer/define-funding-source.md): Set funding source for ticket term (in case of ASYNC tickets, this will execute transfer immediately). Endpoint Permission: Admin, Non-Signing Admin, Signer, Approver, Editor.
- [Delete ticket leg (term)](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/smart-transfer/delete-ticket-leg-term.md): Delete ticket term when ticket is in DRAFT status
- [Find Ticket](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/smart-transfer/find-ticket.md): Find tickets by their title or ticker. You can also query all tickets without filters by not providing any input parameters. **Endpoint Permissions:** Admin, Non-Signing Admin, Signer, Approver, Editor, Viewer.
- [Fund dvp ticket](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/smart-transfer/fund-dvp-ticket.md): Create or fulfill dvp ticket order
- [Fund ticket manually](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/smart-transfer/fund-ticket-manually.md): Manually fulfill ticket, in case when all terms (legs) are funded manually. Endpoint Permission: Admin, Non-Signing Admin, Signer, Approver, Editor.
- [Get Smart Transfer ticket term](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/smart-transfer/get-smart-transfer-ticket-term.md): Find a specific term of a specific Smart Transfer ticket. Endpoint Permission: Admin, Non-Signing Admin, Signer, Approver, Editor, Viewer.
- [Get smart transfers statistic](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/smart-transfer/get-smart-transfers-statistic.md): Get smart transfer statistic
- [Get user group](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/smart-transfer/get-user-group.md): Get Smart Transfer user groups. Endpoint Permission: Admin, Non-Signing Admin, Signer, Approver, Editor, Viewer.
- [Manually add term transaction](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/smart-transfer/manually-add-term-transaction.md): Manually set ticket term transaction. Endpoint Permission: Admin, Non-Signing Admin, Signer, Approver, Editor.
- [Search Ticket by ID](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/smart-transfer/search-ticket-by-id.md): Find Smart Transfer ticket by id. Endpoint Permission: Admin, Non-Signing Admin, Signer, Approver, Editor, Viewer.
- [Set expiration](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/smart-transfer/set-expiration.md): Set expiration date on Smart Transfer ticket. Endpoint Permission: Admin, Non-Signing Admin, Signer, Approver, Editor.
- [Set funding source and approval](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/smart-transfer/set-funding-source-and-approval.md): Set funding source for ticket term and creating approving transaction for contract to transfer asset
- [Set user group](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/smart-transfer/set-user-group.md): Set Smart Transfers user group to receive email notifications for Smart Transfers. Endpoint Permission: Admin, Non-Signing Admin, Signer, Approver, Editor.
- [Submit ticket](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/smart-transfer/submit-ticket.md): Submit Smart Transfer ticket - change status into ready for approval if auto approval is not turned on, or OPEN if auto approval is on. Endpoint Permission: Admin, Non-Signing Admin, Signer, Approver, Editor.

- [Withdraw staked funds](https://developers.fireblocks.com/api-reference/staking/withdraw-staked-funds.md): Withdraws funds that have completed the unbonding period. Typically requires the position to be deactivated first (unstake → unbond → withdraw). Amount and timing vary by chain protocol.
